title: Parcels the shape classifier is least sure of

meta.publisher: City of Vancouver Open Data Portal
meta.local_areas_from: local-area-boundary (City of Vancouver Open Data Portal), point in polygon on the parcel's geo_point_2d; the parcel records carry no geo_local_area field
meta.licence: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Vancouver (property parcel polygons; local area boundary).

how_chosen: Parcels where some of the nudged re-runs (thresholds moved a little; the simplification's 3 degree / 0.5 m tolerances halved and doubled) disagree with the call, lowest agreement first and then nearest a threshold, at most six per pair of classes so the set covers every boundary; multi_part is never uncertain and is left out. Since 12 Nov 2026 only lots a person could build on: a nine-digit site_id (not a strata plan), a civic address, a property-tax-report record of legal type LAND with a land value, a legal description that is not a park, a right-of-way or a road, and a point outside the parks layer; each parcel's `lot` block carries the zoning district at its point and the tax record's legal type, year built and legal description.
